title: Ocoee Trail Nashville Bungalow
description:
A little bit of country & a little bit of rock n' roll! This charming bungalow is perfect for folk who want to visit Nashville, enjoy time poolside and not break the bank! Sleep up to 8. 25-30 min drive ride on Lyft to downtown & the airport (car apps pricing is subject to their terms of driver availability and demand). Near Old Hickory Lake marina. Great proximity to golfing, fishing, hiking and East Nashville.  A variety of  games, cornhole and poolside fun! Pool open mid April-mid October.

The space
Full kitchen, perfect for preparing meals and hosting a gathering. Bedroom number one is the primary suite. There is a king size bed, a full bathroom and walk in closet. Bedroom number two has two twin beds and bedroom number three has a queen size. There is a full size air mattress upon request.

Guest access
This is a private residence. No shared spaces and is entirely accessible to guests with the exception of the basement.

Other things to note
Pool is open mid April to mid October. Check for availability if unsure.
